description: Give a group access to a module (forms, charts, maps, …). A PORTAL group gets one chart, map or calendar per call, by its id; its tables, forms and reports are set_table_permission.

module.description: forms, charts, maps, calendars, files, team, portals, reports, table; for a portal group only charts, maps, calendars

module_id.description: ID of the one module (entity/widget/chart/map…); required for a portal group

portal_group_id.description: Portal group ID (from list_portal_groups or create_portal_group)

user_group_id.description: ID of a team group (or portal_group_id)

name: set_module_permission
